subject: I wasn't going to send this confession about your grades
preview_text: Most users are making one simple mistake that's costing them a full letter grade. I'll show you how to fix it in 2 minutes.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. It feels too raw. But I was looking at the data this morning and saw something that made my stomach drop. A pattern. A simple, fixable mistake that's literally dragging grades down from A- to B- for people just like you.

Here's the truth: the students getting the best results aren't the smartest. They're not spending more time. They're just using one feature differently. They're doing something in the first 60 seconds of opening the app that 90% of users skip. And that one thing changes everything about how their papers get graded.

It's the 'Humanize' button. But not how you think. Most people use it at the end, as a final polish. The top 10% use it FIRST, before they write a single sentence. They let the AI generate the raw structure, then immediately humanize it, THEN build their paper around that humanized core. It bypasses detection at the DNA level, not just the surface.

Open the app right now. Start a new paper. Generate a thesis, then hit 'Humanize' BEFORE you write anything else. See how the entire tone shifts. Your professor will never suspect a thing. P.S. The students who do this are reporting back with comments like 'first A+ in two years' and 'my professor asked if I had a tutor.'
cta_text: Open Thesis Generator & Try This Now
